genreFitEvidence: KOOP's official genre taxonomy and linked programmes include electronica, ambient, house, techno, dub, reggae, jungle/drum and bass, hip-hop, world and world-beat.
The station describes its programming as community-produced and its genre catalogue as continuously changing and expansive.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, bass, dub, reggae and world-fusion releases therefore have plausible programme fit, subject to human track selection and KOOP's editorial judgment.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KOOP expressly welcomes music submissions through a public Music Library mailbox, but it does not publish the current technical delivery method or international, metadata, content and AI-origin requirements. A human must send one asset-free inquiry, confirm the live procedure and select a suitable release. Do not attach audio, provide private links, use the newsletter form, contact individual programmers or infer a postal route before KOOP responds.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The repository code index and current open pull-request context were searched for KOOP, KOOP Radio, music@koop.org and the canonical Contact path. The only unrelated KOOP token found was in a film-director lead file; no prior music-submission-agent platform, runtime seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The purpose-specific Music Library mailbox is stored once as the canonical opportunity. The general mailbox, newsletter form, underwriting and DMCA contacts, individual programmes, staff contacts, phone numbers and postal addresses are excluded as parallel or substitute routes.

notes: One new free-first KOOP Radio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review for a source-verified Music Library mailbox.
